note: 'an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it' (Matt 28:2), and spoke to the women: 'Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified' (28:5).

'Jesus met them' (Matt 28:9). **The second woman is named only as 'the other Mary'** (28:1, repeating 27:61), and Matthew supplies the antecedent five verses earlier: 'Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph' (27:56). She is not Mary Magdalene, who is named beside her in all three verses, and not the mother of Jesus, whom Matthew never places at the tomb. The graph also keeps her distinct from Mary the wife of Clopas (John 19:25); the two are commonly read as one and no verse joins them.
'Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,' (Matt 28:19), spoken to the eleven of 28:16.
'Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.' (Matt 28:16), as directed at 28:10.
